description.message: The key of the page in front of you, drawn as a constellation, as your own machine received it.

noneNotHttps.message: This page was not loaded over https: there is no key to draw.

noneReload.message: Reload this page: a key is read while the page arrives, and this one arrived before Stellar was watching.

untrusted.message: Firefox does not trust this certificate.

seenNew.message: First time this browser sees this sky here. It will remember it.

seenSame.message: The same sky as on $1, when this browser first saw it here.

seenChanged.message: This is not the sky this browser saw here on $1: it was $2. A renewed certificate changes the sky; so does somebody in the way.

seenAccepted.message: Remembered: $1 is now the sky this browser expects here.

checkText.message: This is the key your machine received. Ask stellar.mesa.black whether its server receives the same one: two different keys is what an interception looks like. The name of the site and this fingerprint are sent, only when you press.

checkGo.message: Compare with what the server sees

noneGrant.message: Stellar has not been allowed to read the certificates of the sites you visit yet. It reads nothing else, and sends nothing.
